description: Passwords are hashed with Argon2id at a documented cost; only hashes and signed material are stored at rest, never plaintext secrets.

requirements.description: All passwords must be hashed with Argon2id using documented cost parameters (memory, iterations, parallelism) that meet current security recommendations. Only the resulting hash is stored in SQLite; plaintext passwords must never be logged, stored, or transmitted. Hash verification must use constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks. Cost parameters must be configurable and documented in code.
requirements.title: Argon2id Password Hashing at Documented Cost Parameters

validation.notes: api/internal/crypto/argon2_test.go: hash a password and verify the hash — must return true
api/internal/crypto/argon2_test.go: verify wrong password against hash — must return false without timing difference exploitable by the test
api/internal/crypto/argon2_test.go: assert output format encodes algorithm tag 'argon2id', version, memory, iterations, parallelism, salt, and hash
api/internal/crypto/argon2_test.go: assert two hashes of the same password differ (unique salt per hash)
api/internal/crypto/argon2_test.go: attempt to store plaintext password — no API surface allows bypassing hash; test that the hash function is the only write path
api/handlers/auth/register_e2e_test.go: after registration, query SQLite directly and assert the stored credential is an Argon2id hash string, not plaintext
api/handlers/auth/signin_e2e_test.go: sign-in succeeds using Argon2id verify against the stored hash; assert no plaintext appears in logs during the operation
api/internal/crypto/argon2_bench_test.go: hash operation at production cost parameters completes within an acceptable UX budget (≤ 500 ms); document the measured latency alongside cost params
